title: Vibed a fun driving game
author: JustAKoder
selftext:
I’ve been working on my driving game, Ridge Run, for the past month or so: https://kaviox.com/ridge-run. I wanted to see what Claude and Codex could do with Three.js, procedurally generated worlds, and AI generated assets (just by prompting coding agents). I’ve been super happy with the result and am going to keep iterating on this game and building out others.

The objective of Ridge Run is to drive as far as possible, keep your gas tank full, and earn gold to buy upgrades and new vehicles like a dirt bike and a plane. Would love to hear any feedback you may have!
